Gourde raised tourism infrastructure broadly; Joly's ACOA-funding commitment (given to d'Entremont for the Bar Harbor-Yarmouth ferry) is the closest reply captured. On green economy, Simard contrasted a $1.7B orphan-well cleanup and a $500M EDC loan to the Coastal GasLink pipeline (8.6Mt CO2/year) against the PM's green-recovery task force and against the $500M the whole forestry sector received in 2017 (58,000 Quebec jobs, $6B GDP); Wilkinson deferred climate questions to 'beyond this phase of the crisis,' and O'Regan cited the 2017 softwood action plan rather than matching the liquidity figure. On small business, landlords were refusing to join the rent-assistance program despite 50-100% revenue drops; Morneau said rent relief is provincial jurisdiction but offers landlords up to 75% coverage, and Anand said PPE support beyond front-line health care is still being scoped with the provinces.
